description: SHA-bound audited PTX semantic phase annotations for Phase 3 representative configs (M32_N64_w8, M32_N128_w4, and M32_N16_w8).

tma_setup_and_descriptor.description: TMA descriptor creation, mbarrier setup, proxy fencing, async bulk copy, and wait loop

initial_local_load.description: Initial loading of 8 BF16 elements into registers via 1 x ld.shared.v4.b32

thread_local_reduction_arithmetic.description: Unpack and convert 8 BF16 elements to FP32. Zero thread-local max operations (lanePart[M]=4, 1 elem/thread on M).

intra_warp_reduction_communication.description: 2-stage butterfly shuffle reduction across 4 lanes of M within each warp (offsets 16, 8) for all 8 elements.

cross_warp_reduction_communication.description: 2 rounds of cross-warp shared memory exchange (4 st.shared, 4 ld.shared, 6 barriers) combined via 3-stage butterfly shuffles (offsets 4, 2, 1; 24 shfl + 24 max.f32).

post_reduction_convert_layout.description: Shared memory layout conversion to blocked1 layout via 2 st.shared.v4, 2 bar.sync, and 1 ldmatrix.x1 reload.

global_store.description: Predicated global memory store to output buffer
